g.text: Values below each panel: common endpoint E180 / mean over E171–180 (blue shading). Accuracy is averaged equally over seeds 37 and 53.
Dotted E1–8 segments are replay diagnostics. Dots mark the original E8 checkpoints; solid lines show the continuation. Squares mark the common endpoint.
